ios.desc:
Find out how much you snore, when it happens, and what you can try next.

SnoreStop AI records your night and turns sleep audio into a clear morning report: snore score, night map, replayable audio moments, sleep apnea risk signals, and progress trends.

If you have ever wondered whether you really snore, how bad it gets, or whether you are waking your partner, SnoreStop AI helps you stop guessing.

Wake up to:
• A clear snore score for each session
• A visual night map showing when snoring peaked
• Replayable audio moments from the night
• Snore voice, tone, texture, and frequency insights
• Audio-based sleep apnea risk signals for the session
• Progress trends across multiple nights
• Practical anti-snoring changes to test and track

Built for real nighttime questions:
• Do I actually snore?
• When is it loudest?
• What does it sound like?
• Is it getting better or worse?
• What can I try tonight?

Use SnoreStop AI when you want more than a raw sleep recording. Each morning report helps you understand your snoring, talk with your partner, and test changes one night at a time.

Sleep apnea risk signals are informational only and are not a diagnosis. If you are concerned about sleep apnea, breathing pauses, daytime fatigue, or other symptoms, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

Record tonight. Wake up with answers.
